source_state: Uncommitted working tree; evidence records separate verification snapshots, not a production deployment.
counting_rule: Runs overlap. Do not sum tests/assertions across snapshots or add the entire Administration rerun to the release-filtered suite. The latest 9-test Administration suite replaces its earlier 8-test snapshot; only one test was added.

historical_full_suite.note: Historical snapshot predates later workflow additions and final fixes; no later full-green run is claimed.

baseline_comparison.method: Isolated git archive; copied Composer bootstrap metadata, shared dependency package directories; SQLite test databases, no checkout/reset of working tree.

delta_resolutions.original_failure: Hard-coded Inventory 0.4.0 expectation after intentional source upgrade to 0.5.0.
delta_resolutions.resolution: Expected version updated; passed in release-filtered JUnit.

delta_resolutions.original_failure: Inline admin API URL in PharmacyManagerPage.jsx.
delta_resolutions.resolution: Uses shared route configuration; both route tests passed in release-filtered JUnit.

baseline_comparison.note: 80 reproduced cases are baseline failures, not 82. The two new deltas were fixed separately; the historical full snapshot remains recorded with failures.

focused_broad.provenance: Coordinator-reported broader focused run before final targeted fixes.

owned_transaction_workspace_workflow_rec.provenance: Extracted subset of release-final.junit.xml; not additional tests.

release_filtered.sequence: Before final Administration timezone/GTIN boundary fixes. Contains the previous Administration 8 tests / 92 assertions.

administration_after_final_fixes.sequence: Latest affected-suite rerun after timezone normalization and GTIN zero-padding-only alias fixes. Replaces earlier Administration 8/92 and interim 9/96 snapshots; not additive.

synthetic_browser_tests.note: Synthetic browser fixtures are separate from the actual PHP HTTP test.

route_centralization_tests.note: Already included in backend release-filtered count.

actual_php_http_browser.note: Separate browser run against actual local PHP HTTP server.

frontend.provenance: Coordinator-reported final FE results; route JUnit additionally verified here.

mysql.provenance: Previously reported isolated local MySQL gate runs; scratch databases removed and cleanup verified. These are correctness gates, not capacity measurements.

service_profiles.interpretation: Sequential local service profiles with four streams across independent point warehouses, shared chain/SKU, synthetic one-line OTC sales. Not 50/100 simultaneous streams; not HTTP/WAN or production capacity certification. Short FE build overlap may have occurred; background activity was not independently monitored.

safety_and_release_limits: No environment files, credentials, tokens, patient data or connection secrets are retained in these artifacts.
Business database was not migrated or seeded by these verification runs; MySQL/load runners used guarded random local scratch databases.
External provider production transports, controlled/cold-chain/online release gates and real deployment remain separate acceptance work.
